svg.title: JacoPy file map (2/2): central and geometry packages
svg.text: JacoPy file map (2/2): central and geometry packages
Under jacopy/, generated from the code (2026-10-14, commit 9a11e9b).

Each card is a folder (header right: modules · total lines); rows are module files and line counts. Bold = __init__.py (package facade), gray italic = compatibility alias for an old path. Red number = module over 1,000 lines.
objects: bundle, form, vector field, metric …
TM example: d, L, ι, Cartan, Schouten
